in_hindi.name: सुमैयत
in_hindi.meaning: सुमैयत एक प्राकृतिक नाम है जो अरबी भाषा से लिया गया है
in_hindi.long_meaning: सुमैयत एक अरबी नाम है जो अरबी भाषा के जड़ सुमय से मिलता है। यह नाम अरबी भाषा के वाक्यों में शब्द 'समय' से लिया गया है, जिसका अर्थ है 'समय' या 'समय का साथी'। इसे अरबी में 'समय' के अर्थ में भी प्रयोग किया जाता है। यह नाम हिंदू-पाकिस्तानी समुदाय में बहुत प्रसिद्ध है। इस नाम का प्रयोग प्राचीन काल से ही होता आया है। यह नाम इस्लाम के समय से भी जुड़ा हुआ है। इस नाम को इस्लामिक परंपरा में बहुत सम्मान किया जाता है।

in_english.name: Sumayyat
in_english.meaning: Sumayyat is a feminine given name that means 'listener' or 'hearer'

The name is mentioned in the Quran, where it refers to a woman who was a listener or a hearer. In Islamic tradition, the name Sumayyat is associated with qualities such as attentiveness, vigilance, and obedience. It is also associated with the concept of 'sam', or the ability to hear or listen. In modern times, the name Sumayyat is used in various Muslim cultures, including Arab, Turkish, and South Asian communities. It is considered a beautiful and meaningful name that conveys the importance of listening and attentiveness.

This name signifies the importance of the moon and its significance in Islamic culture. The moon plays a crucial role in the Islamic lunar calendar and is used to determine the shifting of various religious practices, rituals, and observances. The birth of a child during a night where the moon is full or bright is considered auspicious, representing goodness, prosperity, and blessings.

The moon, in Islamic beliefs, signifies revelation and guidance from Allah. Sumayyat's name reflects the belief that even during the darkest times, the light of the moon (Allah's guidance) illuminates the path for a newborn soul. The individual named Sumayyat is believed to be a recipient of Allah's divine grace and blessings, bringing them closer to their faith and spiritual growth.
